Styles References Collecting

Collection practice

Keep the source.
Capture the idea.

A small record with a clear reason is more useful than a folder of unexplained screenshots.

How the catalogue is built

The JSON files in data/ are the source of truth. node tools/build.mjs generates every HTML page, board-data.js, llms.txt, and the api/ and implementations/ folders. Commit the data and the generated files together, so the catalogue still opens without a build. Do not edit generated files. node tools/build.mjs --check fails when they are out of date.

Add a reference

  1. Copy the reference template to data/references/<id>.json. The id is lowercase words joined by hyphens, and it must match the file name.
  2. Record the title, type, medium, source URL, creator if known, when the work was made, and the review date. The reference schema describes every field.
  3. Write observed traits in observed. Put your reading in interpretation and reusable ideas in borrow.
  4. List one or more styles in styles, each with a note and a basis. Use curator when a person placed it and agent when an agent proposed it.
  5. Run node tools/build.mjs. The build rejects unknown styles, broken internal links, and missing image files.

Save images with context

Put local images and screenshots in assets/references/. Each image needs descriptive alt text, a caption, the save date, and the original image URL when there is one. Credit the creator when known. Record the rights tier and license on the reference. When the license is unknown, write unverified. Read the rights page before you store a third-party image.

An image may be the whole reference. Describe its composition, texture, color, and mood. For an uploaded image without a public URL, record who supplied it and its original file name. Do not invent provenance.

Name a style

Copy the style template to data/styles/<id>.json. A style needs a definition, mood words, a visual grammar, rules for agents, and a naming type that says whether the name is established or made by this catalogue. Add a classification rubric, lineage, and a fingerprint when you can support them. Record only external identifiers that you checked.

To give a style an implementation, add data/tokens/<id>.tokens.json and data/specimens/<id>.css. The build writes tokens, CSS variables, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, DESIGN.md, and a specimen page to implementations/<id>/.

Capture a website

node tools/capture.mjs <id>=<url> … opens each URL in headless Chrome with a fresh profile and no cookies, at 1440 × 900. It saves a viewport screenshot to assets/references/<id>.jpg and a measurement to data/measurements/<id>.json. The measurement has two channels: computed styles, and pixels, the palette of the screenshot. For a historical site, use a Wayback Machine address with if_ after the timestamp, which removes the archive toolbar. Look at every screenshot before you write the record. A bot check, a cookie wall, or an error page is not evidence of a design.

Measure other pages

  1. Run python3 tools/serve.py. It serves the catalogue on http://127.0.0.1:8766 and saves measurements that pages send to it.
  2. On a local page, load tools/extract-traits.js and post the result: fetch("/measurements/<id>", {method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(await extractTraits())}). The file lands in data/measurements/<id>.json.
  3. Many third-party pages, including Wayback Machine copies, block requests to a local address. Paste the extractor into the page instead, and copy the JSON out.
  4. For an image file, run python3 tools/image-traits.py <image> --out data/measurements/<id>.json.
  5. Check one measurement with node tools/lint-style.mjs <style> <measurement>. Check that the fingerprints still separate the styles with node tools/lint-style.mjs --matrix.

Measurements count as evidence only for what they measure. A lint pass does not make a page belong to a style, and a real reference that fails is calibration evidence, not an error to hide.

State the evidence

Observed
The live source or supplied image was inspected.
Documented
The notes rely on identified documentation or published examples.
Pending
The reference is saved, but there is not enough evidence for visual claims.
Measured
A tool extracted the values. A measurement is an observation, not an interpretation.
Agent-proposed
An agent placed the reference in a style. No person has reviewed the placement yet.

Keep observed details separate from interpretation. Add dates because websites and products change.

Keep it readable

Put knowledge in headings, paragraphs, lists, links, and figures. Keep all hub styling in assets/hub.css. The catalogue must work as ordinary HTML, with or without JavaScript and CSS.
